issues.where: left of the star's limb, about x 600-720, y 225-240 (crops H and L)
issues.what: a faint greenish-grey horizontal streak floats in empty space, detached from the corona; it looks like a stray sprite or lens-flare leftover
issues.fix: remove the streak, or if it is meant to be a flare, tie it to the light source with a matching hue and falloff

issues.where: left limb (x 760-800, y 300-410) and upper-right limb (crops A, N, Q)
issues.what: red prominences are thin, saturated red squiggles laid over the glow; they have no emission glow, no thickness and a different colour from the corona, so they read as painted strokes on a separate layer
issues.fix: give the prominences volume, an emissive falloff and an orange-to-white gradient where they meet the limb, and blend them into the corona

issues.where: disc surface (crops C, M, R)
issues.what: the photosphere is a soft, airbrushed swirl of noise; at native size there is no crisp granulation or sunspot detail and the texture looks smeared, like a blurred procedural layer
issues.fix: add a sharper granulation layer at small scale, with some limb darkening and a few defined active regions

issues.where: lower limb and the left limb's coronal spikes (crops E, H, Q, R)
issues.what: the coronal loops and radial spikes look like repeated brush-stroke sprites of similar size spaced evenly round the limb
issues.fix: vary the loops' scale, brightness and spacing, and soften the spike ends into the glow

issues.where: whole sky except the lower-left corner (crops A-E, G-L, O-W)
issues.what: the stars are spread at a near-uniform random density with similar sizes everywhere, with no clustering or gradient towards the Milky Way band, so the field reads as procedural noise
issues.fix: change the star density with galactic latitude, add faint unresolved background glow and dust lanes near the band, and widen the range of star brightness

issues.where: lower-left Milky Way patch (crops F, N, S)
issues.what: the Milky Way stops abruptly in the corner, with a fairly hard edge to the brown dust cloud, so it looks like a pasted patch
issues.fix: feather the edge of the nebula layer and carry a faint band of it further into the frame

issues.where: two small galaxy smudges (x 435, y 530; crops D, G, P)
issues.what: the galaxies are tiny orange blurred ellipses that are softer than the stars around them, like upscaled sprites
issues.fix: render them at native resolution with a bright core and a faint disc

issues.where: Milky Way clouds and outer greenish-grey dust transitions in crops A, B, D, F, G, H (also visible in image-13.png, image-15.png crops K, L, O, P, and image-16.png crops T, U)
issues.what: visible pixel-level RGB chroma speckle and gritty sharpening noise in the diffuse Milky Way background texture at native 1:1 resolution
issues.fix: apply gentle chroma denoising to the diffuse Milky Way map prior to star compositing or use a cleaner unsharpened high-bit-depth source map

issues.where: around bright and medium stars embedded in Milky Way nebulosity in crops B, D, F (and image-15.png crops K, O, P; fainter trace around bright stars in image-10.png)
issues.what: 1-to-2-pixel dark negative-lobe ringing halos surround stars where bicubic/Lanczos resampling or unsharp masking depresses the adjacent cloud brightness
issues.fix: resample the sky map without unsharp masking or negative-lobe ringing (clamp filter undershoot) and composite catalog stars additively over the smooth nebulosity

issues.where: lit face, top-right crop and middle-right crop
issues.what: parallel combed furrows run across the sunlit slope, and the grain looks stretched along the grade
issues.fix: remove the directional stretch and break the furrows with finer, isotropic grain

issues.where: sunlit slope of the body, upper right
issues.what: the rock looks waxy and airbrushed, with soft rounded crater lips and a repeated dimple pattern
issues.fix: vary crater size and shape, and replace the smooth highlight with hard micro-shadows

issues.where: shadowed upper right of the body
issues.what: the night side is muddy and nearly empty, with only soft low-frequency bumps
issues.fix: keep the hard terminator, but hold faint high-frequency relief in the shade

issues.where: crops A and F, bright gold knots in the galactic band
issues.what: The brightest knots lose individual star cores in a broad, soft glow, making them look blurred next to the crisp surrounding stars.
issues.fix: Reduce bloom in the brightest knots and preserve the separate cores of the brightest stars.

issues.where: crops S through V, dark sky between bright stars
issues.what: The faintest points merge into a fine blue-gray grain at native size instead of reading as separate stars.
issues.fix: Reduce the density and contrast of the faintest points while keeping the brighter stars sharp.

issues.where: rings, especially the near arc over the lower right of the disc and the far arc upper right (crops A, D, F, H, P, T, U)
issues.what: the rings read as soft smeared brush strokes, like motion blur, with no sharp ringlet edges or gaps at native size; where the near arc crosses the night side it turns into a hazy ghost streak
issues.fix: render the rings from a high-resolution radial profile with crisp ringlet boundaries and gaps, and give the arc in front of the disc proper opacity and lighting instead of a blurred overlay

issues.where: lit upper part of the globe (crops B, H, I, P)
issues.what: the day side is a smooth airbrushed blue with only a few faint cloud wisps, and the terminator is an even, mechanical band across the disc; the surface looks plastic
issues.fix: add banded cloud structure at several scales and storm features, and break up the terminator with altitude and haze variation

issues.where: globe disc (crops D, M)
issues.what: the disc is a flat, featureless black cutout behind a thin blue rim; it has no night-side texture, ringshine or limb darkening, so it looks like a flat mask
issues.fix: add faint ringshine and starlight shading, gradual limb darkening and a softer inner edge to the rim light

issues.where: lower edge of the Milky Way band, about y 250-300 across the full width (crops A, I, J, O)
issues.what: the galaxy texture ends along an almost straight horizontal line, with a strip of different star density under it, which looks like the edge of a texture patch
issues.fix: map the Milky Way on the full sky sphere with a feathered, irregular falloff into the background star field

issues.where: Milky Way dust clouds (crops C, I, J, K)
issues.what: the nebulosity is a little soft and upscaled compared with the sharp stars on top of it, and crop C shows faint circular ripple shapes in the lower left
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution galaxy source, or add detail at native scale, and remove the ripple artifacts

issues.where: ring arc in front of the dark disc (crop M)
issues.what: the ring strands crossing the unlit disc are as bright as the parts outside it, and the planet casts no shadow on them, so the ring looks pasted on top
issues.fix: apply the planet's shadow to the ring and dim the segment that crosses the night side

issues.where: bright star near the centre (crops C, F)
issues.what: the bright star is a soft round blob with no diffraction or point core
issues.fix: render it as a sharp point source with a tight bloom
